name: The Venetian Resort Hotel Casino
positioning: The Venetian, one of two hotels at The Venetian Resort on the Las Vegas Strip, designed as a reimagining of a bustling Italian piazza with gondola rides and all-suite accommodations
best_for: Travelers who want an Italian piazza-style setting with frescos, sculptures and gondola rides
Couples and friends wanting a suite with a sunken living room
Guests who want shows, concerts and a casino without leaving the resort

facts.text: The Venetian Resort comprises two hotels, The Venetian and The Palazzo.
The resort says it has the largest standard rooms on the Las Vegas Strip.
The resort stages concerts, comedy and other shows on site.
Metallica's Life Burns Faster residency plays at Sphere at The Venetian from October 1, 2026 to March 13, 2027.
The resort's restaurants include celebrity chef venues.
Venetian Rewards members earn points on gaming, dining, entertainment and spa experiences.
The Venetian Rewards mobile app lets guests track or redeem points and explore the resort via an interactive map.
The resort hosts meetings, combining suites, dining and entertainment.
Travel + Leisure named the resort among its Top 10 Favorite Hotels in Las Vegas of 2025.

highlights.text: Guests can take a gondola ride beneath bridges and balconies at The Venetian Resort.
The Venetian Hotel is designed as a reimagining of a bustling Italian piazza.
The standard rooms have sunken living rooms.
Accommodations at the resort are all suites.
The Venetian is decorated with frescos and sculptures.

considerations.text: The Venetian shares The Venetian Resort with a second hotel, The Palazzo.
WhataHotel notes the large resort size can mean long walking distances.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury Las Vegas Strip properties.
